name: Mrunmayee Kokitkar
bio: Usually found somewhere between a new idea, a 17-tab brain, and 'wait, hear me out.' I like building things, bringing people together, and turning ideas into actual plans that can be taken to execution, making VAMINT a place where something interesting is always around the corner.

name: Hitesh Khairnar
bio: As the Vice President of VAMINT, our college tech club, I help turn ideas into action while keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes. I look after ongoing plans, coordinate with different teams, get the necessary permissions in place, and make sure everyone's part of the plan actually comes together—without making it feel like a corporate meeting! Along the way, I get to work with my team, organize tech events and competitions, and help create a space where everyone can learn, build, experiment, and have fun with technology.

name: Janhavi Rane
bio: Part-time Secretary, full-time keeper of 'wait, who's doing that?' I'm usually keeping track of plans, people, messages, and approximately 47 things happening at once. At VAMINT, I help keep everyone connected, make sure things don't slip through the cracks, and turn 'we should probably do this' into 'okay, it's happening.'

name: Nakul Kshirsagar
bio: I'm rarely uninterested; I'm usually just one deep dive away from being obsessed!

name: Sristi Sharma
bio: Turning ideas into innovation. As the Technical Head, I'm passionate about all things technology, creativity, and problem-solving. From brainstorming exciting ideas to bringing them to life through technology, I enjoy being part of the journey where innovation meets execution (hopefully without too many bugs).

name: Dnyaneshwar Galkar
bio: I'm the bridge between VAMINT's many moving parts, keeping departments connected, timelines on track, and communication flowing. Basically, I make sure the right things reach the right people at the right time. You'll probably find me keeping track of timelines and knowing exactly what's happening when, sometimes before it even happens.

name: Rishikesh Sutar
bio:
Hey, I'm Rishikesh Arun Sutar — video editor, designer & tech nerd.
Currently exploring Data Science & Gen AI while freelancing.
I take on the work nobody wants to touch — complain about it, then get it done. 🗿
